question: The Board of Control for Cricket in India was established in the year _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1928**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The **Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI)** was established in the year **1928**. It is the governing body for cricket in India and is responsible for organizing domestic and international cricket matches.
 
• The BCCI was formed as a society under the **Tamil Nadu Societies Registration Act**. It is headquartered in **Mumbai, Maharashtra**.
 
• The establishment of the BCCI marked a significant milestone in Indian cricket as it centralized the administration of the sport, which was previously managed by various regional cricket associations.
 
• The BCCI is a founding member of the **International Cricket Council (ICC)**, which was established in 1909. It plays a pivotal role in international cricket governance.
 
• The board organizes major cricket tournaments, including the **Indian Premier League (IPL)**, which has become one of the most lucrative cricket leagues globally.
